title: A canned job with no inactive parts adds all its parts with no warning
custom_preconds: Admin. Canned job whose parts are all active.
custom_steps:
1. WO → New Line → "What are you doing?" → the canned job → Save & Close
  2. Replay POST /api/work-orders/{id}/lines/create-from-canned-line for it
custom_expected:
1. Line holds all the canned parts; no orange warning toast
  2. 201 with warning: null
